instructions.name: apply_emergency_close
docs: Apply emergency close after 24hr timelock. Permissionless.
Closes the Position + Vault PDAs without Meteora CPI.
Any remaining vault tokens are transferred to the position owner.

instructions.name: apply_revenue_dest
docs: Apply a previously proposed revenue_dest change. Permissionless after 24hr.

instructions.name: cancel_pending_revenue_dest
docs: Cancel a pending revenue_dest change. Admin only.

instructions.name: claim_fees
docs: Claim accrued Meteora LP fees -> user (no protocol fee on LP fees)

accounts.name: caller
docs: Caller: authorized bot or vault owner

accounts.name: user_vault
docs: UserVault PDA — gas deducted from here

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Bot closes position: remove all + claim fees + close Meteora position.

accounts.name: user_vault
docs: UserVault PDA — receives rent on close + gas deduction source

instructions.name: close_rover_position
docs: Close a rover position. Bot-gated.
Removes liquidity, claims fees, closes Meteora position,
transfers tokens back to rover_authority ATAs, closes PDAs.

instructions.name: close_rover_token_account
docs: Close a token account owned by rover_authority. Permissionless.
For WSOL: unwraps WSOL balance to native SOL on rover_authority (picked up by sweep_rover).
For empty ATAs: reclaims rent to rover_authority.
Destination is always rover_authority itself — lamports cannot be extracted.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can call — permissionless

accounts.name: token_account
docs: Token account to close — must be owned by rover_authority

instructions.name: create_vault
docs: Create a vault PDA for a user. Anyone can pay rent. The vault is
cryptographically bound to `owner` via PDA seeds — no signer check needed.

accounts.name: owner
docs: means the vault is cryptographically bound to this pubkey regardless.

instructions.name: harvest_bins
docs: Bot harvests fully-converted bins. Anti-backwash mechanic.

accounts.name: user_vault
docs: UserVault PDA — receives harvested tokens, gas deducted from here

instructions.name: initialize_burn_curve
docs: One-shot: snapshot CRANK supply at curve activation, enable burn,
and create the burn_sol_vault PDA that stages SOL for buy-side bids.
Admin only. Errors if already initialized (initial_crank_supply > 0).
Snapshot is read directly from the passed CRANK mint account.

accounts.name: crank_mint
docs: CRANK SPL mint — supply read here for the snapshot.

accounts.name: burn_sol_vault
docs: Burn SOL staging vault. Bin-farm-owned PDA — sweep_rover credits via direct
lamport ADD, wrap_burn_sol direct-debits to fund DLMM bid positions.

instructions.name: initialize_rover
docs: Initialize the rover authority PDA. Admin only. Called once.
The rover_authority PDA owns rover positions. Harvest proceeds
accumulate in its ATAs, then sweep_rover moves SOL to dist_pool.

instructions.name: open_fee_rover
docs: Open a fee rover position from accumulated token fees in rover_authority ATA.
Bot-gated. Uses BidAskOneSide distribution (more tokens at higher bins).
Bot pays rent for Position + Vault PDAs (refunded on close).

accounts.name: bot
docs: Bot-gated — pays rent for Position + Vault PDAs

accounts.name: meteora_position
docs: New position keypair (bot generates)

accounts.name: rover_token_account
docs: Source: rover_authority's token account (accumulated fee tokens)

instructions.name: open_position_v2
docs: Open a DLMM position on behalf of a user vault.
Bot is the tx signer + rent payer. Tokens come from the user vault's ATA.
For SOL-side buys: inline wrapping via lamport manipulation + sync_native.

instructions.name: open_rover_bid_position
docs: Open a buy-side BidAsk DLMM position from rover_authority's WSOL ATA.
Mirrors `open_fee_rover` but: (1) deposits below active_id (buy side),
(2) Y-only (SOL/WSOL) deposit, (3) source ATA is rover's WSOL.
Bot-gated. Bot pays rent for Position + Vault PDAs.

accounts.name: bot
docs: Bot-gated — pays rent for Position + Vault PDAs

accounts.name: rover_wsol_account
docs: Source: rover_authority's WSOL ATA, pre-funded by wrap_burn_sol + sync_native.

accounts.name: meteora_position
docs: New position keypair (bot generates)

instructions.name: open_rover_position
docs: Anyone deposits tokens into a sell-side DLMM position owned by rover_authority.
The harvest bot liquidates these like normal positions. SOL accumulates in
rover_authority ATAs. sweep_rover sends it to dist_pool for all monke holders.
This IS the bribe mechanism — rover TVL ranks pools in the frontend.
Range is hardcoded to 2x current price (or MAX_POSITION_WIDTH bins, whichever
is smaller). The depositor only chooses how many tokens to put in.
Bins are placed from active_id+1 upward (sell side, above current price).

accounts.name: depositor
docs: Anyone can deposit tokens as a rover bribe

accounts.name: meteora_position
docs: New position keypair (frontend generates)

instructions.name: propose_emergency_close
docs: Propose emergency close of ANY position (user or rover). 24hr timelock.
For when Meteora deprecates a pool and normal close_position CPI fails.
NOTE: This can target user positions too — intentional for stuck positions
on deprecated pools. The 24hr timelock gives users time to see and react.

instructions.name: rover_burn_and_mint
docs: Burn CRANK accumulated on rover_authority → mint BANK → forward to
bank-distributor vault for daily Merkle distribution.
Two-step inside one instruction:
1. CPI bank-mint::burn_and_mint with rover_authority as `user`.
Burns rover's CRANK ATA, mints BANK to rover's BANK ATA.
2. transfer_checked from rover's BANK ATA → bank_distributor_vault.
Bot-gated. The full balance of rover's CRANK ATA is burned; caller
passes `amount` for explicit auditability.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Bot-gated.

instructions.name: set_burn_enabled
docs: Toggle the burn kill switch. Admin only.
When false, sweep_rover clamps burn_ratio to 0 and routes all SOL
80% trader / 20% protocol regardless of supply position on the curve.

instructions.name: set_fee_bps
docs: Direct admin-gated fee setter. Replaces the prior propose/apply timelock.
Defensively clears any in-flight pending_fee state from the prior pattern.

instructions.name: set_trader_dest
docs: Set the trader reward destination. Admin only.
Must be called before sweep_rover will include trader share.

instructions.name: sweep_rover
docs: Sweep SOL from rover_authority via the curve.
Splits into burn_sol (→ burn_sol_vault), trader_sol (→ trader_dest),
protocol_sol (→ Config.bot). Permissionless — anyone can call.
Errors if the burn curve has not been initialized.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can call sweep — permissionless

accounts.name: crank_mint
docs: CRANK SPL mint — supply read here for the burn curve.

accounts.name: burn_sol_vault
docs: Burn SOL staging vault PDA — receives the burn portion of the curve.

instructions.name: unwrap_wsol_in_vault
docs: Unwrap WSOL in vault back to native SOL.
Closes the vault's WSOL ATA — token balance returns to vault PDA,
ATA rent returns to caller (bot paid for creation, bot gets rent back).
Called after harvest/close that produces WSOL, or before withdraw_sol.

instructions.name: update_gas_lamports
docs: Admin sets gas reimbursement amount per operation.

instructions.name: user_close
docs: User or bot closes position. Caller must be authorized bot or vault owner.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Caller: authorized bot or vault owner (real wallet)

accounts.name: user_vault
docs: UserVault PDA — authorization checked in handler body (dual-caller)

instructions.name: vault_burn_and_mint
docs: CPI wrapper: burn CRANK → mint BANK via bank-mint, on behalf of user vault.

instructions.name: vault_vote
docs: CPI wrapper: vote on gauge weights via gauge-voter, on behalf of user vault.

instructions.name: withdraw_sol
docs: Withdraw native SOL from user vault to the vault owner's wallet.
Caller must be authorized bot or the vault owner.

instructions.name: withdraw_token
docs: Withdraw SPL/Token-2022 tokens from user vault ATA to owner's ATA.
Caller must be authorized bot or the vault owner.

instructions.name: wrap_burn_sol
docs: Move SOL from burn_sol_vault to rover_authority's WSOL ATA.
Bot calls this, then calls SPL `sync_native` in the next ix of the same tx.
Direct lamport manipulation is allowed because both accounts are addressable
here: burn_sol_vault is bin-farm-owned (debit allowed), rover_wsol_account
is token-owned (credit-add allowed for any program).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Bot-gated.

accounts.name: rover_wsol_account
docs: Rover authority's WSOL ATA. Receives lamports here; bot calls SPL
`sync_native` in the next ix to update the WSOL token balance.

instructions.name: wrap_sol_in_vault
docs: Wrap native SOL in user vault to WSOL in the vault's WSOL ATA.
Uses direct lamport manipulation (bin-farm owns the vault PDA) + sync_native CPI.
Bot calls this before open_position_v2 for SOL-side buys.

types.name: BurnSolVault
docs: Burn SOL staging vault PDA. Bin-farm-owned (so we can direct-debit lamports
without going through system_program::transfer with PDA signer + ownership
edge cases). Holds native SOL between sweep_rover and wrap_burn_sol.

types.name: PoolAllocation
docs: Pool weight allocation for gauge voting CPI

types.name: PositionCounter
docs: Per-user-per-pool counter for deterministic meteora position PDA derivation.
Enables multiple positions per pool without requiring a keypair signer.

types.name: RoverAuthority
docs: Rover authority PDA — owns rover (bribe) positions.
Harvest proceeds accumulate here. sweep_rover splits SOL via the supply-driven
burn curve into three destinations:
burn_ratio        → burn_sol_vault PDA (staging for buy-side CRANK bids)
trader_sol_frac   → trader_dest (bridge_vault, distributed as SOL via Merkle)
protocol_skim     → Config.bot (operations)
burn_ratio = min(1.0, (current_supply / initial_crank_supply) / 0.75)
protocol_skim = 0.20 * (1 - burn_ratio)
trader_sol_frac = 1 - burn_ratio - protocol_skim
Kill switch: when burn_enabled = false, burn_ratio is clamped to 0 and
all SOL flows 80% trader / 20% protocol.
`revenue_dest` and its timelock fields are LEGACY — held for backwards-compat
of the on-chain account layout but not referenced by sweep_rover anymore.

types.name: UserVault
docs: Per-user vault PDA. Holds SOL + token ATAs. Replaces custodial keypairs.
Seeds: [b"user_vault", owner.as_ref()]
owner = user's real Solana wallet (immutable withdrawal destination).
